comment: Fountain codec goldens. The 'toy' codec group pins the ABI v2 surface (size helpers, in-place init, ESI semantics, push/ready/decode) with deterministic vectors generated from the formula block[i]=(i*7+3)&255, systematic ESIs 0..15, repair ESI 16 = XOR of all symbols; lossy_repair drops source ESI 5 and recovers it through the repair. 'nanorq' roundtrip landed with W3.2 (extraction tool in tools/); 'lt' roundtrip landed with W3.3 (extraction tool in tools/). W6.11 adds supported K/symbol boundary geometries extracted through the same public ABI.

nanorq.provenance: extracted by tools/gen_goldens_fountain.c through the public fountain ABI from the vendored RaptorQ (multiple K/symbol geometries; each entry lists its K, T, overhead and ESI set)

lt.provenance: extracted by tools/gen_goldens_fountain.c --codec lt through the public fountain ABI (multiple K/symbol geometries; robust-soliton repairs, xorshift64* seeded per ESI)
